message: every episode ready to upload today carries a first-person [HUMAN] Producer POV with no entry in pov/pov-assignments.json: how-is-a-silicon-wafer-made, how-strong-is-graphene, what-is-a-semiconductor-made-of. Uploading one would be the channel asserting she said something no interview records her saying.
unblock:
Two honest ways, and a validator may not do either for her.

1. She reads the [HUMAN] line in scripts/<slug>.md, and if it is hers it is recorded in pov/pov-bank.json with `source: owner-approved <date>` and given an entry in pov/pov-assignments.json - the precedent set on 2026-09-05 for how-are-microchips-made, how-does-quenching-harden-steel and how-do-self-healing-materials-work (pov-099..101).

2. The episode is re-cut without the beat.

Nothing is deleted either way: the renders stay on the shelf and this lane picks them up the run after the assignment lands.
disposition_why: 'POV_UNTRACED' is not in loop/stop_policy.json, so it is treated as needing a human. That is the default on purpose.
